headline: Bitcoin recovers toward $79,000 following major crypto security breach
summary: Bitcoin rebounded toward $79,000 as markets absorbed the impact of the largest crypto hack to date. Concurrently, oil prices declined amid reports concerning diplomatic approaches toward Iran.
why: Bitcoin is the leading cryptocurrency by market capitalization, serving as a primary benchmark for digital asset sentiment and valuation across global markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: The asset's price clawed back toward $79,000 as markets shook off the hack.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Bitcoin recovered toward $79,000 as the broader market shook off the effects of the largest crypto hack.
